description: List the payment accounts (Zahlungskonten): bank accounts (Bankkonten), clearing accounts (Verrechnungskonten) and cash registers (Kasse), each with its balance (Saldo) at a day, today in Berlin by default. The balance is sevDesk's sum of the transactions it knows, not necessarily the bank's figure. IBANs show only their last four characters. Balances are fetched for at most 25 accounts per call. Use an account id with sevdesk_transactions_list to see its transactions (Umsätze).

asOf.description: Balance at the end of this day, YYYY-MM-DD; default today (Berlin).

name: sevdesk_bank_accounts_list
title: List sevDesk bank accounts
